r5-central-scrutiny.title: CENTRAL: U=2.0 clip is genuine under-call finding, not characterize-layer bug
r5-central-scrutiny.imperative: Rule explicitly on whether u_braking=2.0 and u_fast_corner=2.0 for all 10 cases reflects a real ceiling under-call (APPROVE) or a pipeline bug (BLOCK). Check: progress registration correctness, b_b<0 fallback in capability_envelope, Gsat ceiling absence, straight regime as pipeline sanity signal.
r5-central-scrutiny.finding: RULING: GENUINE UNDER-CALL FINDING. Not a characterize-layer bug. Three lines of evidence: (1) Registration: resample_by_progress normalises both sim-grid and driver-lap to progress fraction u=s/s_total before interpolating. This is correct; a small misregistration shifts points but cannot push ALL 10 diverse cases (4 circuits, 5 teams) uniformly to exactly the 2.0 clip in braking AND fast_corner simultaneously. A registration bug producing that pattern would also corrupt u_straight but u_straight shows circuit-sensible variation (0.56 Monza lift-coast, 1.2-1.5 Monaco full-throttle). (2) Ceiling under-call mechanism confirmed in code: car_prior.py lateral.ceiling=None always (module docstring: 'not fabricated'); CapabilityEnvelope.from_parameters: ceiling_trustworthy=False when ceiling is None (Gsat fallback absent); braking: b_b<0 cases fall back to braking_grip_ratio x lateral (population ratio), which is known conservative from decision:smoother_rounds_braking_knee - the braking frontier underestimates peak decel because the GP prior fights the braking knee (MEMORY: 'raw p99 5.3g vs smoothed p90 4.3g'). When b_b>=0, the measured frontier is still low (same root cause). Both paths produce a too-low braking ceiling. (3) Straight regime is pipeline-health signal: u_straight 0.56-0.58 at Monza (lift-and-coast F1 circuit), 1.2-1.5 at Monaco (full-throttle street circuit) is physically correct and circuit-discriminating. If the pipeline were inverted or broken, straight would not produce this sensible result. Conclusion: U=2.0 for braking/fast_corner everywhere is the two-sided evaluator signal firing per-regime (decision:ideal_lap_sim_two_sided_evaluator - small/negative gap = under-call). CONTEXTUAL verdict is honest. APPROVE.
